verdict.rationale: Factory documents its own event-driven actions: assigning a Linear or Jira issue, or mentioning @Factory, triggers Droid to implement the work, and Droid reviews pull requests in CI. Software Factory also references "persistent automations" and putting code review on "autopilot". However, no documentation shows users defining their own rules that map events or conditions to actions, and droid exec in CI is a building block rather than a rule engine. missing for 10: a user-configurable rule/trigger definition surface, documented event types and conditions, docs on configuring persistent automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
